newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dragonair receives 5th Airbus A330.
newsitem.headline: Dragonair receives 5th Airbus A330.

text.p: Hong Kong Dragon Airlines Ltd (Dragonair) said it has taken delivery of its fifth Airbus A330.

The new 322-seat twinjet, on lease from International Lease Finance Corporation, flew into the territory for the first time on Sunday (June 22) after an official handover ceremony at the Airbus headquarters in Toulouse, France.

The arrival brings Dragonair's all-Airbus fleet to 12. The Hong Kong-based regional carrier has outstanding orders for the purchase of one more A330 to be delivered late next year and two Dragonair said its A330s, powered by Rolls-Royce Trent 700 engines, are operated on high-density routes between Hong Kong and Beijing, Shanghai, Xiamen and Kaohsiung.
The aircraft can carry up to 15-17 tonnes of containerised cargo, said Airbus Industrie.
The new aircraft will allow increased capacity on existing routes and the opportunity to open new routes in the region, Dragonair said in a statement.
